meta.title: Flagged for Review
meta.rule: A flag never asserts a value. It states what is verified, what is unknown, and what would settle it. Nothing on this page blocks the release.

resolution_log.what: 301 of 345 injury rows had never been re-checked by a second reader.
resolution_log.now: All 345 rows re-transcribed independently and diffed: 1,725 injury cells, 0 mismatches.

resolution_log.what: The site's injury join used a five-club pilot while 31 clubs were already collected.
resolution_log.now: Full join published on pages/availability.html; pilot kept as a labelled subset.

resolution_log.what: The live-pipeline tree was linked from nothing.
resolution_log.now: Linked from index.html and the nav; check_links.py now asserts every tree is reachable.

resolution_log.what: tools/check_links.py failed with 111 errors on main (red verify-site workflow).
resolution_log.now: 0 errors. Two causes: JS template literals parsed as hrefs, and no per-tree contract for live/.

flags.item: No league-wide official depth chart exists.
flags.verified: nfl.com publishes team rosters and schedules, but no league-wide starter/backup chart. Individual clubs publish charts on their own sites.
flags.unknown: Whether a club chart is authoritative. Detroit's page says '2026 Unofficial Depth Chart'; Green Bay's says 'Unofficial, Nov. 10, 2026'.
flags.settles_it: Owner decision Q-05 on the acceptable verification tier; or a licensed depth feed.

flags.item: Depth charts collected for 5 of 32 clubs only.
flags.verified: BUF, SEA, DET, GB and BAL charts were read and transcribed row by row on 2026-11-14.
flags.unknown: The remaining 27 clubs. Their depth fields are deliberately blank, not inferred.
flags.settles_it: Q-14: extend capture to all 32 clubs under a stated cadence.
flags.source_label: Buffalo Bills depth chart (one of five captured)

flags.item: No odds, prices or historical lines exist in this repository.
flags.verified: Nothing in the repo contains a price. NFL.com articles cite a commercial book with a timestamp, which is a third-party snapshot and not a licensed feed.
flags.unknown: Every fair line, edge, expected value and closing-line value. All are therefore unpublished.
flags.settles_it: Q-02: a licensed quote feed with timestamps and limits.
flags.source_label: NFL.com picks page (odds attributed to a commercial sportsbook)

flags.item: No strategy has been scored, and the leaderboard is empty by design.
flags.verified: Validation gates, ranking objective and reward structure are specified and machine-readable in data/gates.json.
flags.unknown: Whether any candidate strategy has skill. Publishing a ranking now would be fabrication.
flags.settles_it: A scored test window under Q-12 after Q-01 and Q-02 are resolved.

flags.item: No correlation value is published, and none can be yet.
flags.verified: The estimator, the power calculation and the multiple-comparison correction are documented in docs/methodology/correlation.md.
flags.unknown: Every rho and every joint probability. Detecting rho = 0.10 needs roughly 780+ paired observations before conditioning.
flags.settles_it: Q-10: multiple seasons of licensed joint player-market outcomes.
flags.source_label: Current official snapshot — the only verified data held

flags.item: Sportradar's status as exclusive official NFL data distributor is reported, not read off an NFL.com page here.
flags.verified: Multiple independent outlets report the 2015 appointment and 2019 expansion to sportsbook operators.
flags.unknown: The current contractual text in 2026. It may have changed since the sources describing it.
flags.settles_it: A primary NFL or Sportradar release for the current term, or legal advice.

flags.item: Three other agent sessions worked this repo concurrently and produced divergent coordination boards.
flags.verified: Branches arena/a78e0158-x1, arena/226be516-x1 and arena/6f377170-x1 exist. a78e0158 marked all tasks done while pushing no artifacts.
flags.unknown: Whether those sessions will push content later and overlap with this release.
flags.settles_it: Review COORDINATION.md handoff log; merge or reject their PRs on their merits.

flags.item: One transcription error was found and fixed during verification.
flags.verified: Arizona was first typed as 2-6; the official page prints 3-6 with PCT .333. ESPN and FOX both list Arizona at 3-6.
flags.unknown: Whether any other row is mistyped but internally consistent. Mechanical checks cannot catch a plausible wrong number.
flags.settles_it: A second independent human or agent pass over each table against the live official page.
flags.source_label: ESPN Cardinals team page (3-6, 4th NFC West)

flags.item: The official standings page prints an unrendered template token in its heading.
flags.verified: The page heading literally reads '$year$ NFL $displayname$ Standings' at retrieval.
flags.unknown: Nothing material — the table itself is correct and complete. Recorded because it is an irregularity on an official page.
flags.settles_it: No action; noted so a future reviewer does not mistake it for a scraping error.

flags.item: Some officially listed players sit oddly on their club's depth chart.
flags.verified: Arizona's Budda Baker is listed on the Week 10 report (full participation) while the Cardinals chart does not place him; Seattle lists Quenton Nelson at LG; Puka Nacua appears on the Rams' Week 10 report with no designation while NFL.com news reports a likely IR placement.
flags.unknown: Whether these reflect trades, scheme changes or chart staleness. The cause is not stated by any source read.
flags.settles_it: Per-player transaction lookup in the official transaction hub before any of these rows is used as a feature.

flags.item: Reward funding, eligibility and jurisdiction are unresolved.
flags.verified: The NFL Gambling Policy caps prizes at $250 in related contests for NFL Personnel and bars personnel from sports-betting operations.
flags.unknown: The owner's entity, jurisdiction, funding source and contest terms.
flags.settles_it: Q-07 and Q-08, with jurisdiction-specific review.
flags.source_label: NFL Gambling Policy for NFL Personnel (2022)

flags.item: Every published table is a snapshot and will go stale.
flags.verified: All tables state a 2026-11-14 retrieval date; the injury report is week-specific and changes daily.
flags.unknown: How quickly a reader will notice. Staleness is certain, not hypothetical.
flags.settles_it: Q-17: a refresh cadence plus a visible staleness rule.

flags.item: Two independent transcriptions agree, but agreement is not proof.
flags.verified: 32 clubs x 7 fields and 345 players x 4 fields were compared against an independently produced second transcription on main; 0 disagreements across 1,604 values.
flags.unknown: Whether both readers made the same systematic error (wrong column, mislabelled header). An agreement test cannot detect a shared blind spot.
flags.settles_it: A third independent read, or the league's own structured data feed.

flags.item: Week 10 Thursday final predates the snapshot clock, so that game's price-snapshot captures are post-hoc.
flags.verified: The WAS-NYG final (24-21) was played 2026-11-12; the repository snapshot clock is 2026-11-14. The store therefore records 3 open rows as captured_post_final and 3 close rows as not_captured_before_kickoff for that game.
flags.unknown: Whether any true pre-kickoff capture for that game exists anywhere upstream. No such capture is claimed.
flags.settles_it: Suggestion S-15 (kickoff-timestamped capture) plus a decision on whether pre-existing captures, if any, may be imported.
flags.source_label: NFL.com Week 10 schedule — Thursday final and dates

flags.item: 16 starters appear on the official injury report with no replacement named on the club's own depth chart.
flags.verified: From the 897-row deficiency join: 16 rows have starter_on_report = true and an empty replacement. Every other on-report starter has a named 2nd or 3rd string.
flags.unknown: Whether the club chart simply stops listing players or the next man up is genuinely unavailable. The league publishes no depth chart to settle it.
flags.settles_it: Manual read of those 16 clubs' chart pages, or an official league depth-chart source (Q-05).

flags.item: Three completed games carry a model line of exactly 0.0, so the signal grade excludes them as no-pick.
flags.verified: MIN at CHI (Week 2), GB at TB (Week 4) and DAL at IND (Week 9) have model_spread = 0.0 in data/processed/games_modeled.csv. The grade records 133 decided of 137: 1 tie and 3 no-pick excluded, both counts published.
flags.unknown: Nothing — the exclusion rule is stated on the published grade.
flags.settles_it: No action; documented behaviour. A future rule could break ties with model_home_win_prob, but that would be a new pre-registration, not a patch.

flags.item: One tie sits in the results feed (Giants 27, Commanders 27, Week 5) and is excluded from the decided sample.
flags.verified: The official Week 5 page prints the game Final with both scores 27; the standings show both clubs with a tie (NYG 3-1-1, WAS 1-3-1 at that point).
flags.unknown: Nothing — a tie is a real outcome, handled as such.
flags.settles_it: No action; the feed carries is_tie and the grade reports n_ties_excluded = 1.

flags.item: Team-code aliases ARI/AZ and LAR/LA must be normalised to join official reads to the mirror and to the model file.
flags.verified: Without normalisation 9 Arizona games fail the join (nflverse writes ARI, NFL.com prints AZ); with it, all 137 games join and the build asserts it. Known earlier as I-16/I-15; re-confirmed with a build-time check this round.
flags.unknown: Nothing — both codes are published by their own sources; only the join is normalised, never a displayed value.
flags.settles_it: No action; the assertion in tools/build_results.py keeps it from regressing.

flags.item: Two in-repo models publish different Week 10 lines and neither has been designated the origination of record.
flags.verified: For WAS-NYG the ratings model (data/lines/originated_lines_2026_week10.csv) posts the away spread -0.5, while the walk-forward Poisson (data/processed/model_lines / games_modeled) posts home margin +3.09. Both files are in the repository with diagnostics; the snapshot store cites the ratings model, the ST-11 signal grade cites the Poisson.
flags.unknown: Which number is 'the' fair line when they disagree — that is question Q-23.
flags.settles_it: Owner designates one model of record; the other becomes a published cross-check column.
flags.source_label: Origination-order table (model of record for this round)

flags.item: The published 2026-11-14 standings are already false for 2 of 32 clubs.
flags.verified: The official nfl.com standings page, read live on 2026-11-15, shows DET 7-2-0 (PF 257, PA 199, net +58, 5W) and NE 5-5-0 (PF 221, PA 242, net -21, 2L). The published data/nfl/standings.tsv says DET 6-2-0 (222/189/+33, 4W) and NE 5-4-0 (211/207/+4, 1L). Both differences are the one Munich game, which the official Game Center reports as NE 10 - DET 35, Final. 12 of 256 compared cells differ; the other 30 clubs are identical.
flags.unknown: Whether the site should serve a dated snapshot (what it does now, correctly labelled 2026-11-14) or track the live page. That is a product decision, not a data one.
flags.settles_it: The diff is already published beside the table (data/verification/2026_11_15/standings_diff.json). The remaining choice is whether the landing page should show the snapshot date more loudly, and whether a scheduled capture at a fixed UTC hour should replace the ad-hoc one.
flags.league_source_label: Game Center: NE 10 - DET 35, Final, Munich

flags.item: A live game page shows a box score that is not a result, and any scraper that reads it will record a false final.
flags.verified: At 2026-11-15T18:1x UTC the official Week 10 schedule page listed KC@ATL, HOU@CLE, MIN@GB, MIA@IND, CAR@NO, BUF@NYJ and JAX@TEN as in progress with the score reading 0-0 for every one of them, at the same moment the same page showed NE 10 - DET 35 as Final. A parser that keys on 'a score is present' would write nine 0-0 finals into the results feed.
flags.unknown: How long the 0-0 window lasts on each game, and whether the feed flips to a real score before or after the game is marked Final.
flags.settles_it: Settle results only on the page's explicit Final status AND a Game Book PDF existence check, never on the presence of a score. The Munich game already exposes its Game Book at static.www.nfl.com/image/upload/v1794764592/gamecenter/ab582c2f-4feb-11f1-abca-2c54536568a9.pdf.
flags.league_source_label: Game Center with Game Book link
